goal: Close the remaining exact-binding gaps from the failed CogTools Lab corpus run, reuse its 29 evidence-ready 2021-2023 rows without repeating them, and produce an audited 90-publication plus one-hop teaching synthesis without treating formal analogy as cognitive proof.
context: The prior confirmed dispatch closed error in its explorer wave. Its durable research.md contains 29 ready middle-period rows and 36 modern byte-bound but semantically unread rows; 25 historical rows and the teaching lane are absent. The recovery must parse transient PDF bytes with installed pypdf or pdfminer, preserve source-page drift and exact selectors, keep PDF bytes out of the repository, and cap each native wave at two agents because the host accepted two concurrent spawns and rejected a third.
anti_bias_global: Recovery completeness and interpretive integrity under temporal-prior, source-corpus, and attack-vector disagreement.

groups.anti_bias: Composite temporal-prior and source-corpus axis: modern semantic recovery versus historical-lineage acquisition.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs modern semantic recovery for 2024-2026 while agent 1 runs the 2009-2020 historical lineage on the temporal-prior and source-corpus axis; a bias in agent 0 toward current cognitive-tools and AI framings would be exposed by agent 1's earlier visual-communication record, while a bias in agent 1 toward retrospective continuity would be exposed by the modern papers' changed methods and concepts.

agents.angle: Semantic repair of all 36 byte-bound 2024-2026 rows using in-memory pypdf or pdfminer extraction and exact page selectors.
agents.initial_prompt: Repair only the modern semantic gap recorded in the prior EVIDENCE-CLOSURE.md and Agent 1 section of the prior research.md. Re-fetch every one of the 36 assigned PDFs transiently, verify URL, byte count, and SHA-256 against the prior manifest, and parse in-memory bytes using pypdf.PdfReader(BytesIO(bytes)) or pdfminer when needed; do not rely only on command-line PDF tools. For each row return drift status plus a concise paraphrased capsule covering question, method/data/participants, principal result, stated limitation, cognitive-tools or representation relevance, and exact PDF page or named-section selectors. Preserve publication/version ambiguity, including related Chen entries and bourouis2023open. Do not persist PDF bytes, recursively crawl citations, quote more than 25 words from one paper, infer comprehension, or treat computational analogy as cognitive proof. Return explicit expected/observed/closed/unclosed/drift counts.

agents.angle: Historical-lineage acquisition of all 25 2009-2020 publication rows with original terminology and exact paper selectors.
agents.initial_prompt: From the current CogTools Lab papers page, enumerate every page-metadata entry from 2009 through 2020; expected count 25. For every row return entry id, authors, year, exact title, venue/status, PDF URL, companion code URL if any, HTTP/media type, byte count, SHA-256, and a concise paraphrased capsule covering question, method/data/participants, result, limitation, and relevance to cognitive tools or representations. Parse transient PDF bytes with pypdf or pdfminer and cite exact PDF pages or named sections. Preserve historical terminology rather than rewriting it as later cognitive-tools or reflection-tower language. Do not persist PDFs, recursively follow references, quote more than 25 words from one paper, or invent continuity. Return explicit expected/observed/duplicate/failed/unclosed counts.

agents.angle: One-hop teaching-reading and research-framing recovery with access residue and Tier-A deduplication.
agents.initial_prompt: Audit the current teaching and research pages. Freeze all seven course descriptions and five directly linked public syllabus or course surfaces, then follow exactly one hop from teaching.html and enumerate every publicly visible assigned, recommended, or course-reading paper. For each reading return course, source surface and selector, citation, DOI or stable URL, access status, relation to the 90 Tier-A papers, and a concise role-in-course note. Deduplicate by DOI, normalized title, and authors/year, preserving uncertain matches. Parse transient public PDFs with pypdf or pdfminer when required, but do not retain bytes or recurse into bibliographies. Record authentication, JavaScript, permission, or mutability blockers rather than guessing. Bind the research page's cognitive-tools framing separately and do not call course inclusion teaching-effectiveness evidence. Return course, surface, accessible, reading, added, duplicate, and unresolved counts.

Reconcile the recovery returns with the prior research.md Agent 2 middle-period return. Require 90 unique Tier-A rows partitioned 36/29/25, exact binding status for every row, source-page drift accounting, Tier-B teaching deduplication, and explicit inaccessible-surface residue. Produce the complete manifest, temporal and thematic maps, teaching-to-research correspondences, contradictions, and a crosswalk to horizontal representations, vertical residue promotion, and round-trip comprehension labeled direct evidence, local synthesis, analogy, or open hypothesis. Availability is not comprehension; model alignment is not cognitive proof. Build the exact-binding closure candidate and route source-read or selector gaps only through the declared explorer feedback edges.

groups.anti_bias: Attack-vector axis: precedent ownership versus non-vacuity and reproducibility.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs precedent and source-owner classification while agent 1 runs row-level non-vacuity and reproducibility on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward narrative ownership would be exposed by agent 1's exact counts and rereads, while a bias in agent 1 toward mechanically complete but historically unowned claims would be exposed by agent 0.

agents.angle: Precedent and theoretical-owner attack across lab papers, external teaching readings, and local cross-paper claims.
agents.initial_prompt: Verify theoretical and source ownership for each major synthesis claim. Classify claims already-owned, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean using exact paper rows and bounded primary sources. Attack invented novelty, origin, or continuity and preserve the difference among lab publications, external teaching readings, course descriptions, and local synthesis. Precedent never emits KILL.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity and reproducibility attack over 90-row closure, digest drift, selectors, teaching deduplication, and stratified rereads.
agents.initial_prompt: Recompute the 90-row partition and test every failed, drifted, or ambiguous row plus at least two stratified rereads per temporal bin. Test duplicate links, HTML-as-PDF, changed bytes, missing selectors, wrong year bins, inaccessible syllabus surfaces, publication-status conflation, and title-only capsules. KILL results that cannot survive concrete checks while distinguishing exact coverage from sampled semantic audit.

agents.angle: Definitional and scope attack separating records, renditions, readings, cognitive tools, analogy, and comprehension evidence.
agents.initial_prompt: Require distinct invariants for site entry, paper, PDF rendition, publication status, course reading, code artifact, snapshot completeness, permanent bibliography, structural extraction, cognitive effect, and human comprehension. Attack formal-to-cognitive proof leaps and course-inclusion-as-effectiveness claims. Require the horizontal, vertical-residue, and round-trip crosswalk to label direct support, synthesis, analogy, and open hypothesis. Return KEEP/MERGE/RENAME/DEFER/KILL.

Write findings.md only after exact-binding closure. Include the 90-row manifest, teaching additions and residue, drift and digest accounting, paraphrased capsules with selectors, temporal and thematic synthesis, teaching correspondences, contradictions, the horizontal/vertical/round-trip crosswalk, verdict matrix, and prioritized program implications. State that formal analogy is not cognitive proof, access is not comprehension, the run is not human evidence, snapshot completeness is not permanent completeness, and PDF bytes were not retained.

Audit findings.md against the recovery goal and exact-binding contract. Require 90 unique Tier-A dispositions partitioned 36/29/25, successful retrieval bindings, explicit drift and ambiguity, one-hop teaching closure or residue, actual paper-read capsules, copyright-safe paraphrase, reviewer dispositions, and strict separation of extraction, analogy, cognition, comprehension, authority, and publication. Return ACCEPT or one bounded writer revision.
